DEFAULT '', `event_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `receiver` varchar(15) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `parent_order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `storefront_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `user_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `actor_user_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `actor_company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `sender` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `recipients` text, `recipient_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `numbers_accepted` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `partial_accept` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', `message` text, `masked` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', `lang_code` char(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `encoding` varchar(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `pages` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `is_test` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', `batch_no` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `batch_total` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `api_code` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `code_source` varchar(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'api', `api_msg_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `points_charged` decimal(14,2) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `balance_after` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `api_unix_ts` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `api_request` mediumtext, `api_response` mediumtext, `duration_ms` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`message_id`), KEY `idx_created_at` (`created_at`), KEY `idx_status_created_at` (`status`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_event_id` (`event_id`), KEY `idx_order_id` (`order_id`), KEY `idx_parent_order_id` (`parent_order_id`), KEY `idx_company_created_at` (`company_id`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_api_msg_id` (`api_msg_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:kwtsms_attempts` ( `attempt_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `message_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `outbox_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `retry_of` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `source` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `event_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `receiver` varchar(15) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `parent_order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `storefront_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `user_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `actor_user_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `phone_raw` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `phone` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `outcome` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `reason` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `ip` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL, `is_test` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', PRIMARY KEY (`attempt_id`), KEY `idx_created_at` (`created_at`), KEY `idx_phone_created_at` (`phone`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_ip_created_at` (`ip`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_outcome_created_at` (`outcome`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_order_id` (`order_id`), KEY `idx_parent_order_id` (`parent_order_id`), KEY `idx_message_id` (`message_id`), KEY `idx_created_outcome_test` (`created_at`, `outcome`, `is_test`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:kwtsms_debug_log` ( `log_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `level` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info', `action` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `message` text, `context` text, `duration_ms` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `request_id` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `user_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`log_id`), KEY `idx_created_at` (`created_at`), KEY `idx_level_created_at` (`level`, `created_at`), KEY `idx_action` (`action`, `created_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:kwtsms_templates` ( `template_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `event_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `receiver` varchar(15) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`template_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uniq_event_receiver` (`event_id`, `receiver`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:kwtsms_template_descriptions` ( `template_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `lang_code` char(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `body` text, `is_edited` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', PRIMARY KEY (`template_id`, `lang_code`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:kwtsms_outbox` ( `outbox_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `retry_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `expires_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `attempts` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `reason` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `phones` text, `message` text, `context` mediumtext, PRIMARY KEY (`outbox_id`), KEY `idx_status_retry_at` (`status`, `retry_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;
